data.title: Arknights: Endfield Beta Test II Access Distribution Now Underway
data.brief:
Dear Endministrator,
Access to Arknights: Endfield Beta Test II is now being distributed. Use the methods below to check if you've been granted access.
data.data:
Dear Endministrator,

Access to Arknights: Endfield Beta Test II is now being distributed. Use the methods below to check if you've been granted access.


▼// Beta Test II Check Access Page

Go to the Beta Test II Check Access page and log in using the Gryphline Account you used in the survey. Click [Check Now] to view your status.

Check link: https://endfield.gryphline.com/en-us/checkAccess


▼// Access Notice Email

The email linked to the Gryphline Account you used during the survey will serve as your [notification email] and [login account] for this test.

Check the email you signed up with to see if you've received an access notice. Be sure to check your Spam or Promotions folder, as the message may have been filtered there.


▼// Important Notes

1. Beta Test II is only open to adults. If you are a minor under the laws of your country or region, you are not eligible for test access. If the age you provide in the survey is found to be false, your test access will be revoked.

2. All content available for experience in Beta Test II is from a work-in-progress build and does not represent the final look and quality of the game.

3. Beta Test II access, accounts, and game clients must not be sold, shared, or transferred. Violations will result in your access being revoked. Also, do not change your linked account after access is granted, as this could cause your access to become invalid. Keep your personal account safe to avoid unnecessary losses.

4. Beta Test II access is valid only for this testing phase and limited to one per Gryphline account. Selected Endministrators will be granted access to both PC and mobile (Android or iOS, based on their survey response). Game data will sync across platforms when using the same account.

5. The test server will be closed and all data will be deleted after the test ends.


Thank you again for your continued interest and support for Arknights: Endfield, Endministrator!
